main_text.head: CAP. XI. De alimentis quæ sumuntur ex fructibus.
main_text.p: NB.Arias, multiplices ac infinitas esse fructuum species atque differentias in natura rerum, ei etiam fatendum est, qui à patrio solo non longe receßitquin annus variorum fructuum feracißimus abunde id teftatur.

Verum quoniam non omnes in cibo admittuntur, nimisque operosum foret ac prolixum de omnibus fructib. feorsim pertractare (tum quod in horum multis magnæ vitæ infidiæ subsint, tum etiam, quod major fere eorum pars voluptatis gratia magis, quàm vtilitatis ac salubritatis causa vsurpatur) eos hic annotabimus solum, qui salubritatem magis, quam voluptatem respiciunt. Gorgias Siculus Rhetor, Empedoclis discipulus, natus annos 109. interrogatus, quanam vitæ ratione tam optime vixisset, respondit, nihil voluptatis gratia faciendo. Hodie voluptatis gratia nihil intentatum relinquit gula in arborum fructibus, qui palatum sæpe torpidū, ventremq; cibis aliis refertissimum, alliciût atq; inuitant magno sæpe valetudinis incommodo. page.notes: Left margin: "NB." printed beside the paragraph starting "Verum quoniam". Right-hand edge of the page is damaged and partly cut off; the final line "quan-" is cut off at the edge and continues beyond the scan. Text is slightly faded in places, especially "Arias" (possibly "Arius" or "Arias" – uncertain), and the word "fatendum" (may be "fatendum") and "receßitquin" are read as printed. Some letters in "vsurpatur" and "vtilitatis" are uncertain because of the ink; the reading "vsurpatur" is plausible but not certain. Tear/stain at the top right, not transcribed.
